title: Moose Evolving Pipeline
description: Build an ingest pipeline from Postgres to ClickHouse with a daily revenue aggregation, then evolve the schema to add region and device columns with a backfill, then expose the results through an HTTP API.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build a pipeline, evolve its schema, and expose an API — three lifecycle phases that compound the value of typed schemas and automated migrations.

tasks.description: Load events from Postgres into ClickHouse and create a daily revenue aggregation table.
Add region and device columns, load a second batch of events, and backfill historical rows.
Stand up an HTTP API on port 3000 serving revenue-by-region and top-products endpoints.

infrastructure.description: Postgres seeded with two event tables (v1 and v2). ClickHouse installed but not running.
